metadata.title: Main Bhi Bharat।The Pathalgadi Movement in Gujarat।गुजरात में पत्थलगड़ी आंदोलन | English captions
metadata.description:
The districts of Bharuch, Dang, Valsad, Sadodara, Surat, Sabarkhantha and Panchmahal in Gujarat come under Schedule 5 of the Indian constitution. This schedule makes special provisions in tribal areas to give autonomy to the tribal society to run the administration according to their customs. In 1996 a new law called PESA was passed by the parliament of India to give special powers to the gram sabhas in schedule 5 areas. But both these provisions, Schedule 5 of the constitution and PESA, are not implemented in the state of Gujarat. 
Three activists including Babita Kachap from Jharkhand were arrested by the Gujarat ATS and put in Jail recently for campaigning for the implementation of Schedule 5 and PESA in the tribal areas of the state.
